weaknesses.title: SYS IN auto-swaps inverted bounds — overnight windows wrong if used raw
weaknesses.detail: SYS IN hour 22 6 treats bounds as 6..22 continuous. Hour 12 wrongly IN (1); hour 23 wrongly OUT (0). Real freeze 22-06 needs OR of IN(hour,22,23) and IN(hour,0,6). Catalog says inclusive membership but swap is a silent semantic trap for wraparound schedules.
weaknesses.repro: SYS IN 12 22 6 → 1; SYS IN 23 22 6 → 0 (both wrong for overnight freeze)

weaknesses.title: No local timezone — UTC hour only via TIME/DIV/MOD
weaknesses.detail: Agents must DIV epoch 3600 MOD 24 for UTC hour. No TZ form; local maint windows need external offset.

weaknesses.title: Window tokens need peel + dual NUM shuttle; no LO-HI parse form
weaknesses.detail: AFTER ':' then BEFORE/AFTER '-' then NUM each. REPLACEALL rebuild for set needs STR lo/hi (numeric REPLACEALL footgun class).

weaknesses.title: GREP name matches cousins; COUNTLINE suffix fails
WRITE often omits final trailing newline
SYS IN / SYS BETWEEN name collision across planes
weaknesses.detail: IN is numeric range membership; BETWEEN peels text between delimiters. Agents may confuse BETWEENN alias of IN with text BETWEEN.
weaknesses.repro: forms: SYS IN x lo hi vs SYS BETWEEN open close hay

workarounds: Overnight LO>HI: if CMP lo hi > 0 then OR of IN(h,lo,23) and IN(h,0,hi) — never raw IN(h,lo,hi)
UTC hour: TIME DIV 3600 MOD 24; override CUBALC_MW_HOUR for tests
Identity: BEFORE ':' + EQS — not GREP name
STR before REPLACEALL for numeric LO/HI in templates
PRINT_JSON only utc_hour/n_frozen/n_open; keep bag on plate
language_gaps: Wraparound / circular range membership (overnight hours, modular intervals)
Optional no-swap mode for SYS IN when order encodes wrap
Structured field peel for name:LO-HI tokens
String concat; PRINT_JSON newlines; WRITE force NL
Doc cross-link IN vs BETWEEN vs BETWEENN clearly
issues_faced: SYS IN auto-swap is the main language trap for maint freezes — proven with 12 and 23 on 22-06
mesh:0-0 is always frozen (point window) — intentional edge for IN inclusive endpoints
